Question
========

Betrachten Sie die Balkendiagramme. Welche Balkendiagramm zeigt den stärksten Zusammenhang?


```{r}
p1 <- mtcars %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = am, fill = factor(vs)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "A")


p2 <- mtcars %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = hp < 123, fill = factor(am)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "B")



p3 <- mtcars %>% 
  ggplot() +
  aes(x = hp < 123, fill = mpg > 19) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(title = "C")

```

```{r out.width= c("30%", "30%", "30%"), fig.show = "hold"}
p1

p2

p3
```



Answerlist
----------
* A
* B
* C
* keine Antwort möglich



Solution
========



Answerlist
----------


* Falsch
* Falsch
* Wahr
* Falsch
